title: Goyal, Greer review interim trade agreement as India-US race against tariff deadline
summary: The two sides discussed trade ageeement elements, including enhanced market access, digital trade, supply chain resilience, reduction of non-tariff barriers, and expanded cooperation in strategic sectors, the government said in a statement on Wednesday.
